resources.string: Recommended: deepseek-flash for fast, accurate financial-news translation. The model and endpoint are prefilled; enter your API key.
Recommended: qwen-mt-flash for a good speed/quality balance. The model and endpoint are prefilled; enter your API key.
Qwen-MT uses dedicated translation settings and the finance domain automatically; the general system prompt is not sent.
When the app opens, translate all uncached article titles in the background. Cached titles are not requested again.
Keep showing titles already translated and cached when automatic translation is turned off.
